description: Fixture corpus for the version 1 live-view channel of docs/API.md section 18.2. Valid cases must decode and re-encode to the byte string recorded in canonical.json; invalid cases must be refused with the recorded reason. The corpus deliberately contains no binary frame payload: the payload is a separate transport message described only by the live.frame metadata that precedes it, and a fixture carrying image bytes inside JSON would encode exactly the shape this protocol forbids.

valid.name: stream-attached
valid.note: The first message an authorised viewer sees. It names the project the viewer was authorised against and states retention never, so ADR-0009 is visible on the wire rather than only in a document.

valid.name: frame-metadata-session-room
valid.note: Session-room metadata at the 1440x900 preset. byte_length describes the binary message that follows; the bytes are not here.

valid.name: frame-metadata-thumbnail-after-drops
valid.note: Thumbnail mode at reduced dimensions, reporting three frames dropped since the previous delivery. A sequence gap is expected behaviour under docs/ARCHITECTURE.md section 6.3, not an error.

valid.name: quality-state-viewer-falling-behind
valid.note: The scheduler's own decision, still inside the 10 to 20 band for session_room. The viewer is told what was applied, not what it asked for.

valid.name: quality-request-thumbnail
valid.note: A viewer request. Every field is advisory; docs/API.md section 18.2 leaves the worker scheduler authoritative.

valid.name: stream-heartbeat
valid.note: Carries the sent, dropped, depth and capacity figures docs/TESTING.md section 12 requires to be measurable, and a fractional measured rate.

valid.name: viewer-heartbeat
valid.note: Viewer progress. The rendered sequence trailing the sent sequence is what identifies a slow viewer.

valid.name: session-state-capture-unavailable
valid.note: An ACTIVE session with live_capture false: the degraded case of docs/DEVELOPMENT.md section 11, where navigation and screenshots still work and only the live stream is missing.

valid.name: error-worker-failed
valid.note: A stream failure carrying both the stable code and the docs/UX_FLOWS.md section 18 state the page must show. retryable false, so the viewer must not reconnect in a loop.

valid.name: error-rate-limited
valid.note: The docs/API.md section 19 live-viewer limit, returned with the retry hint that section requires.

invalid.name: attached-with-retained-frames
invalid.note: ADR-0009 and docs/SECURITY.md section 14 fix live_frames: never. retention is a single-valued enumeration, so a stream cannot advertise a retention period even by mistake.

invalid.name: frame-without-stream-id
invalid.note: Frames name the stream instance they belong to, so a viewer can discard a frame from a producer run it no longer follows rather than painting it.

invalid.name: frame-payload-over-bound
invalid.note: byte_length is bounded by max_frame_payload_bytes in the schema, so the relay refuses an oversized frame before it reads one.

invalid.name: frame-with-embedded-payload
invalid.note: docs/API.md section 18.2 separates metadata from payload. additionalProperties false is what stops a base64 field being added back later without a schema change.

invalid.name: session-state-url-with-control-characters
invalid.note: The URL is page-derived (ADR-0010). A terminal escape sequence cannot travel through it into an operator's log.

invalid.name: quality-request-out-of-range
invalid.note: A viewer cannot ask for a rate outside the declared bound, so a viewer-driven resource attack has to get past the schema first (docs/API.md section 19).

invalid.name: unknown-message-type
invalid.note: Human takeover is out of scope for this channel; a pointer message is rejected here, never ignored. Input arrives on /ws/v1/browser-sessions/:sessionId/control when it arrives at all.

invalid.name: unknown-protocol-version
invalid.note: Stage 0 pins version 1 and does not best-effort parse a later one.
